ov: أجازة غرام هو فيلم رومانسي مصري من إخراج محمود ذو الفقار وبطولة فؤاد المهندس، شويكار، نجوى فؤاد، صلاح نظمي ونعيمة وصفي. صدر الفيلم في 11 سبتمبر 1967.
plotEn: Magdy works as an engineer at the High Dam, in Aswan and is taking a leave of absence from work to travel to Cairo and meet his family again. He plans to spend more time with his wife, Laila, who works as a doctor in a hospital, but she is busy for him with her work all the time. This makes him attracted, at this period, to talk to his neighbor Ilham. He visits her all the time in her apartment, taking advantage of her husband's travel, and things develop between them rapidly.
